text:
You need someone who can help build Manychat bots for your agency clients on a regular basis.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, and I’ve built conversational and recommendation systems that focus on engagement and conversion. In a project for Tidewater Outfitters, I built similar-items and “you-may-also-like” carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and cached in Redis, which increased click-through rate by 14% in a 4-week A/B test.

For your Manychat work, I can help structure flows, improve lead generation paths, and support ongoing bot builds in a reliable, repeatable way. I’m comfortable working with NLP, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, and PyTorch when deeper automation is needed. I’d be glad to support your agency on a steady basis.
